species.real: Unused millstones still lie scattered under Stanage Edge, and a millstone is the emblem of the Peak District, which in 1951 became Britain's first national park.
species.name: Gritling

dex.text: A lump of gritstone with a temper and a fondness for the edges of the moor. Grinds its teeth when it is thinking, which is why nobody asks it to think for long.
dex.fact: Millstone grit, the coarse rock that forms the Peak District's edges, was quarried for millstones for centuries.
